info.title: API.SH: Home Depot
info.description: The Home Depot API from API.SH: public Home Depot data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Full product details for one item: title, brand, model, UPC, price, was price, price per unit, promotion, specifications (grouped and flat), description and highlights, key features, images, videos, documents, breadcrumbs, rating and review count, variants (sibling items with their option values), and fulfillment for the chosen store/ZIP (pickup stock at the store, ship-to-home and delivery dates).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/homedepot-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 9-digit Home Depot item id (the number at the end of a homedepot.com/p/… URL).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A homedepot.com/p/… product URL, instead of id.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Home Depot store number for prices and pickup stock (default 121, Atlanta). Takes precedence over zip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP: the nearest store is used for prices and pickup stock, and delivery dates are for this ZIP.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one product, 10 per page, with rating statistics (average, count, distribution, recommended). Each review: title, text, rating, date, author, location, verified purchase, incentivized, syndication source, helpful votes, pros/cons, secondary ratings, photos, videos and brand responses. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/homedepot-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 9-digit Home Depot item id.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A homedepot.com/p/… product URL, instead of id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (relevant = Home Depot's default, photo reviews first).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with these star ratings, comma-separated (1-5).

parameters.name: verified_only
parameters.description: 1 = only verified purchases.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews that mention this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Keyword search or a category/filter listing on homedepot.com, 24 products per page: item id, title, brand, model, price, was price, price per unit, promotion, rating, review count, pickup and delivery availability for the store, images, badges and URL. Also returns the listing's filters (each option carries a `nav` value; pass it back as `nav` to apply it), applied filters and breadcrumbs. A keyword Home Depot maps to a category is followed to that category listing (`redirect_url`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (Home Depot lists at most 30 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/homedepot-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords. Required unless nav or url is given.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: nav
parameters.description: Category/filter N-value: the part after N- in a homedepot.com /b/…/N-… URL, or a filter option's `nav` from a previous response.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A homedepot.com category page URL (/b/…/N-…), instead of nav.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: Home Depot store number for prices and pickup stock (default 121, Atlanta). Takes precedence over zip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP: the nearest store is used for prices and pickup stock, and delivery dates are for this ZIP.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Home Depot stores near a US ZIP code, nearest first: store id (the store_id the product and search routes take for local price and stock), name, distance in miles, phone and address.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/homedepot-stores

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles (max 250).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stores (max 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: use a store id as store_id on /homedepot/v1/product or /homedepot/v1/search for that store's price and stock

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
